checks.result: The exact clean commit passed all 16 mandatory foundation commands and all 138 foundation tests. Build provenance reported 0.1.0+g5ef232e clean; UI reference identity, generator reproducibility, ADR governance, CI policy, quality, packaging, backlog, and the mandatory UI-change gate all passed.
All 29 focused design-first, CI history/base, task-lineage schema, and protected-ADR tests passed at the exact evidence commit.

ADR-0003 and the indexed decision registry cover all protected enforcement-control changes across the exact 26-file task range.
The authoritative ledger and generated planning views validate without drift before evidence attachment.

evidence: Every governed user-interface implementation range is derived from immutable base/head Git trees and must have exactly one task-bound contract with exact changed-file coverage.

Intentional design changes require a different approved reference from the base, exact governed package hashes, a human approval commit, and strict approval-before-every-implementation-commit ordering across full history.

Missing contracts, reuse of the base reference, approval and implementation in the same commit, incomplete file scope, policy weakening, and protected-control changes in the same range fail focused regressions.
The approved-reference-implementation path and defect-restoration path both pass using the unchanged current approved reference package.

Defect restoration must cite the exact reference lineage and provide both a defect statement, expected approved behavior, and focused evidence; the schema and Git-tree validator reject incomplete or mismatched metadata.
Intentional changes require approval_kind human, a canonical human identity, a human-and-agent-review task gate, and a normalized approver identity distinct from the implementation agent.
A focused adversarial test proves agent:owner cannot use human:owner to self-approve, and another proves approval must strictly precede implementation.
The repository human review gate remains the identity-authentication boundary; the machine gate binds that declared identity to the exact approved package and immutable commit ordering.
